Class SoundManager

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.sounds.SoundManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISoundManager
public class SoundManager extends Object implements ISoundManager
Manages all sound effects and background music for the game. Provides methods to play specific sounds, toggle sound effects and background music on/off.
